initial_condition: Uniform theta = 0.20 cm3 cm-3 in both HYDRUS and MAIZSIM before the drip event.
drip_source_formulation: Partial-width surface flux boundary applied through the Richards water mover.
boundary_conditions: No-flux side boundaries, free-drainage bottom boundary, atmospheric top boundary outside the drip source, root uptake and evaporation disabled during the HYDRUS-MAIZSIM event comparison.
baseline_definition: Same soil, initial condition, domain, boundary conditions, and time period without drip irrigation.

hydrus_mesh.area_or_volume_weighting: Nodal control areas exported as area_cm2; axisymmetric volumes exported as axisym_volume_cm3 when applicable.

maizsim_version: MAIZSIM validation build based on commit 199627a4a68e464dfd7c31d2cc65f1de26b54972 with frozen drip parameters
observation_source: HYDRUS node-level theta export from the archived independent validation project.

reference_identity.dataset_title: Independent HYDRUS surface-drip benchmark export for loam
reference_identity.doi_or_accession: local validation archive accession to be replaced by repository DOI

reference_data_provenance.export_tool_or_protocol: HYDRUS node output exported to CSV by the validation post-processing script
reference_data_provenance.spatial_support: HYDRUS nodal control area with area_cm2 weights
reference_data_provenance.time_selection: Output record at 2.0 h after drip event start
reference_data_provenance.preprocessing_steps: Converted HYDRUS coordinates to x_cm and depth_cm; retained node-level theta and control-area weights without calibration fitting.

independence_proof.case_selection_protocol: Selected before running the journal-readiness validation suite to cover soil texture, emitter rate, and event duration diversity.

uncertainty_basis.theta_sd_source: HYDRUS export or measured uncertainty column provided in hydrus_csv as theta_sd
uncertainty_basis.coverage_level: one standard deviation used for readiness 2sd residual coverage checks

comparison_coordinate_system: x_cm horizontal coordinate; depth_cm positive downward from soil surface.
calibration_note: MAIZSIM drip source-width and pressure parameters were frozen before this independent validation run; this HYDRUS theta field was not used for calibration.
